Frozen stale-source cases ONT-STALE-001 and ONT-STALE-002 put those IDs in expected_uncovered_concept_ids with no stale list. Phase 2 tests consuming the matrix would expect uncovered where this contract requires stale.

MAJOR: Coverage decision table keeps status ambiguous when ambiguous_concepts.total_count > 0 even if other concepts are covered. check_cases.py treats expected_status ambiguous as requiring an empty covered set. Those rules disagree.

MINOR: Valid examples are synthetic (project_id 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111, locator version current, digest f×64). The check validates shape, ordering, integer arithmetic, and the decision table; it does not reopen current source. The implementation receipt states that limit.
MINOR: No valid example has a nonempty stale_concepts collection, so the stale branch of the decision table is unexercised by the valid set.
